obligor_aliases: Florida Health Sciences Center, Inc. d/b/a Tampa General Hospital

moodys.citation_text: TGH was downgraded by Moody's from A3 to Baa1 in 2020 in connection with $569M of new debt for the expansion program, with a stable outlook assigned at the time. No subsequent Moody's rating action surfaced between 2020 and the 2024 outlook revision to positive. Therefore Baa1/Stable was in effect on 2022-12-31. The Moody's URL for the 2020 action ('A3->Baa1 + Baa1 assigned to three bond issues totaling $569M') is referenced by St Pete Catalyst but the primary Moody's press release URL is not extracted.

sp.citation_text: Bond Buyer Oct 2025 disclosure: 'S&P Global Ratings maintains A-minus with stable outlook.' No S&P rating action on TGH reported between 2022-12-31 and 2025-03-31 in available trade press; thus A-/Stable inferred for the entire window including the snapshot date.

fitch.citation_text: Per St Pete Catalyst on the 2020 Fitch action accompanying the $569M new debt: 'Existing Debt: A rating affirmed; New Debt Rating: A assigned to the proposed debt issuance; Outlook: Upgraded from stable to positive.' That 2020 positive outlook combined with no surfaced Fitch downgrade implies A/Stable or A/Positive was carried into 2022-12-31. We record A/Stable as the conservative starting point; outlook may have already been Positive by snapshot.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Affirmed Baa1; outlook revised to positive from stable
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Reflects TGH integration of three new hospitals (Bravera Health acquisition closed December 2023, $294M deal) while meeting budget; expanded system now encompasses six hospitals and 150+ care locations across Hillsborough, Citrus, Hernando, Pasco, Pinellas and Palm Beach counties.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Becker's: 'Tampa General Hospital's outlook was upgraded to positive from stable by Moody's, reflecting the health system's integration of three new hospitals in 2024 while meeting budget. Tampa General Hospital has a Baa1 rating with the agency.' Corroborated by Bond Buyer ('Tampa General Hospital, Florida, gets positive outlook').

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Affirmed A; outlook revised to positive from stable on health care facility revenue bonds and hospital revenue bonds (October 16, 2025 — POST-WINDOW)
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Robust revenue growth, EBITDA margin 8.3% in fiscal 2024 expected to exceed 9% by fiscal 2027; unrestricted cash and investments $1.48B at FYE 2024; Medicaid and self-pay under 25% of revenues.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Bond Buyer Oct 16 2025: 'Fitch Ratings raised outlook from stable to positive on A-rated health care facility revenue bonds and hospital revenue bonds.' NOTE: This action is October 2025, AFTER window_end 2025-03-31, so excluded from outcome computation.

moodys.citation_text: Moody's revised outlook to positive during 2024 (exact date not pinned); Baa1 affirmed. No further Moody's action between that point and window end 2025-03-31.

sp.citation_text: Bond Buyer Oct 2025: 'S&P Global Ratings maintains A-minus with stable outlook.' Implies no S&P rating action during the window; A-/Stable carried through 2025-03-31.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch outlook revision to positive came October 2025 (post-window); on 2025-03-31 Fitch stood at A/Stable. The pre-revision outlook was Stable per the Bond Buyer Oct 2025 reporting language.

outcome_class_rationale: Moody's revised outlook on Baa1 to Positive during 2024 (window). No rating change by any agency. S&P stable, Fitch stable through window end. The Fitch positive outlook came October 2025 (post-window). Net: positive outlook revision by 1 agency, no rating change.

new_actions.rationale: Growing revenues and other factors. Affects IDR and Series 2024A&B (Florida DFC) and Series 2020 A/B/C (Hillsborough County IDA) bonds.
